thesis.problem: The companies that actually fit solar panels, batteries and heat pumps are small local electrical firms, thousands of them, each with a handful of technicians and no way to bid for a national customer or to make the finished system talk to the electricity market. The bottleneck in electrifying a house is not the hardware but the trade that installs it.
thesis.solution: 1KOMMA5° buys those installers and puts them on one platform, then connects everything they fit to Heartbeat AI, software that pools the batteries, heat pumps and cars it has installed into a virtual power plant and trades their flexibility. The installers give the company reach. The software is what it expects to be valued on.

disputed.note: The €430m reported is €215m of equity plus €215m of optional acquisition currency.

sources.title: 1KOMMA5°: The Newest Unicorn in the CleanTech Industry
sources.quote: 1KOMMA5° has become a unicorn! Only 23 months after our foundation, we have reached a valuation of 1 billion US-Dollar, a testament to the hard work and dedication of our team.

sources.title: 1KOMMA5°: The Newest Unicorn in the CleanTech Industry
sources.quote: We are humbled and grateful to have raised 215 million Euro in equity for this mission, exceeding our target volume of 150 million Euro due to oversubscription.

sources.title: 1Komma5 raises €150m to pave way for IPO
sources.quote: German solar startup 1Komma5 has raised €150m, paving its way to a public listing. The funding is led by the California State Teachers’ Retirement System (Calstrs), a state pension fund.

sources.title: Hamburg’s 1KOMMA5° has raised €430 million - and just became a unicorn at just 23 months old
sources.quote: Hamburg’s 1KOMMA5° has raised a €430 million series B round, and has shot into the coveted a unicorn spot in just 23 months. The round was led by G2VP and Ben Kortlang will join the board as vice chairman.

sources.title: 1KOMMA5° extends pre-IPO round
sources.quote: To date, 1KOMMA5° has raised almost €400 million in equity and remains debt-free.
